highlights.title: In-Depth Reading Scenario Guides
highlights.description: Explore practical guides for academic research, local LLMs, and note distillation—including Zotero workflows, Ollama setup, Readwise migration, and Obsidian bidirectional links.

highlights.title: Upgraded Core Runtime & Dependencies
highlights.description: Upgraded the underlying Electron runtime and build dependencies to secure releases, reinforcing child process isolation and day-to-day reading stability.

highlights.title: Refined Web & Documentation Experience
highlights.description: The website and guides now feature tactile paper-textured backdrops and dynamic CJK font subsets that slash payload by 93% for a crisper browsing experience.

highlights.title: Reading Layout & Sidebar Visibility Fixes
highlights.description: Fixed sidebar layering near page footers on long articles and refined multi-device typography, keeping navigation clear across all window sizes.
